props.text: General cleaning in Manchester, whenever you need it

Cleaniq Services provides general cleaning in Manchester and across Greater Manchester. Our general clean is a thorough, whole-home clean of your kitchen, bathrooms, bedrooms, living areas, stairs and hallways, carried out by vetted local cleaners who follow the same checklist on every visit.

Book a general clean as a one-off when life gets busy, before guests arrive or after a hectic few weeks, or set it up weekly or fortnightly to keep your home in great condition. You choose the day, the arrival time and how many hours you need when you book, so you only pay for the cleaning your home actually needs.

Book your general clean online in a few minutes or call us on [07846 726428](tel:+447846726428). If your home needs more than a general clean, our [deep cleaning](/service/deep-cleaning-manchester) goes further, and you can add [oven cleaning](/service/oven-cleaning-manchester) or [carpet cleaning](/service/carpet-cleaning-manchester) to any visit.

props.text: Frequently Asked Questions: General Cleaning Manchester

items.q: What is included in a general cleaning service?
items.a: Our general clean covers all main living areas: kitchen surfaces and appliances, bathrooms and toilets, bedroom and living room dusting and vacuuming, hard floor mopping, and bin emptying. You can also request specific extras when booking.

items.q: How often should I book a general clean?
items.a: Most customers book fortnightly, which keeps the home in great condition between cleans. Weekly cleans are popular for larger families or busy households. One-off cleans are also available for any occasion.

items.q: Do I need to be home during the clean?
items.a: No — many of our regular customers provide a key or entry code and go about their day. All our cleaners are vetted, insured, and trusted to work independently in your home.

items.q: Do you bring your own cleaning products and equipment?
items.a: You choose: use your own supplies, or we bring eco-friendly cleaning products and equipment for £10 per visit. Just let us know when booking.

items.q: What Manchester areas do you cover for general cleaning?
items.a: We cover all of Greater Manchester including City Centre, Salford, Didsbury, Chorlton, Stockport, Trafford, Wythenshawe, Ancoats, and surrounding postcodes.

items.q: Can I book a one-off general clean?
items.a: Yes. Book a single general clean whenever you need one, or set up weekly or fortnightly visits if you'd like regular cleaning.

items.q: How much does general cleaning cost in Manchester?
items.a: General cleaning is charged by the hour. You choose how many hours you need when you book, and the current rate comes straight from our booking system.

items.q: How long does a general clean take?
items.a: It depends on the size of your home and how much needs doing. You choose the number of hours when you book. If you're not sure, call us on 07846 726428 and we'll help you decide.

items.q: What's the difference between a general clean and a deep clean?
items.a: A general clean covers the everyday areas of every room. A deep clean goes further, reaching inside appliances and cupboards, behind furniture and built-up limescale and grime.

items.q: Can I add oven or carpet cleaning to a general clean?
items.a: Yes. Add oven cleaning or carpet cleaning when you book, or book them separately.

items.q: What if I'm not happy with my clean?
